tips: LNO: Is this a Leverage, Neutral, or Overhead task? (Shreyas Doshi)
Four Risks: Value, Usability, Feasibility, Viability (Marty Cagan)
Pre-mortem: Imagine this failed. What went wrong? (Gary Klein)
The best PRD answers WHY before WHAT.
Customer problem first, solution second. Always.
Acceptance criteria: Given/When/Then for every requirement.
Cross-platform dependency? Check if Integration Review is needed first.
What are we NOT doing by choosing this? (Opportunity cost)
